facts.text: Gillett began as Riedelville, named after entrepreneur John Riedel, but postal officials changed the spelling to Riddleville in 1871.
In March 2025, the Gillett‑Lone Star Community Cemetery Association unveiled a Texas Historical Marker to honor the town’s historic cemetery.
The community first settled around the Civil War era at the crossroads of the San Antonio‑Victoria and Helena‑Seguin roads, a key trade route.
Ecleto Creek, a tributary of the Guadalupe River, runs near Gillett, and a dam built on it in 1869 powered local mills.
By 1882 Riddleville boasted a Methodist church, a school, a physician, and two general stores, reflecting rapid early growth.
